declarations.name: Resources.TreeFold.run_node
declarations.header_raw:
theorem run_node [Add C] (entry : C) (empty : β)
    (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β C) (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    run entry empty combineRun (.node a l r) =
      ((combineRun (run entry empty combineRun l).1 a
          (run entry empty combineRun r).1).1,
        ((run entry empty combineRun l).2 +
          ((run entry empty combineRun r).2 +
            (combineRun (run entry empty combineRun l).1 a
              (run entry empty combineRun r).1).2)) + entry)

    (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β C) (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :

      ((combineRun (run entry empty combineRun l).1 a
          (run entry empty combineRun r).1).1,
        ((run entry empty combineRun l).2 +
          ((run entry empty combineRun r).2 +
            (combineRun (run entry empty combineRun l).1 a
              (run entry empty combineRun r).1).2)) + entry)

mathematical_assessment.generic_operation: One ordinary Trees.fold sequences actual left, right and combining callback results and charges structural entry last. Add alone preserves exact order/grouping; no commutativity, zero, order, default payload or separate recursive cost evaluator is imposed.
mathematical_assessment.value: Unconditional value erasure and entry-independence use the actual callback first projection. Global callback value compatibility is explicitly sufficient for the specialized pure fold; fold/map and value fusion preserve actual outputs without claiming a paid extra pass.
mathematical_assessment.reweighting: Generic additive monoid homomorphism maps the same execution; its AddMonoid assumptions do not make the raw Add-only operation unnecessarily commutative.
mathematical_assessment.natural_cost: Entry change yields W_entry=W_0+entry*(2*numNodes+1); lower bound, constant callback formula and upper bound retain all entry/nil costs. A single fixed k/K is quantified over callbacks on actual child summaries from arbitrary subtrees, not a size-dependent bound or a global condition on unreachable summaries.
mathematical_assessment.scalar_clients: Actual size/height runs, empty cases and three explicitly associated inorder append callbacks are connected to both values and observations. Per-node append work is left_length+1, left_length+3 or2*left_length+3; actual sample totals15,23,25 are distinct despite identical inorder.
mathematical_assessment.cached_clients: Actual measured fold calls existing nodeRun; returned annotated tree is used for recursive validity, erase/read, exact size/height work and list-cache recurrence. Structural/callback costs remain separate, sample size/height21 and list-cache27 use real operations. No recomputation or erasure pass is silently charged or supplied.
mathematical_assessment.product_and_ordered_clients: Product observations project actual structural and callback costs and reweight through their sum. Additive FreeMonoid traces preserve actual ordered callback/entry occurrences; sample word[0,2,3,1] and singleton[0,0,1,0] differ from collected[1,0,0,0], refuting noncommutative entry collection.
mathematical_assessment.reachable_boundary: resetStep returns summary0, costs0 on actual reached(0,0) child summaries and7 on unreachable(1,0). Both recursive calls still contribute structural work; it witnesses why the zero reached bound need not be a zero bound on all arbitrary summaries.
